request.style: English, male baritone voice, solo, acoustic guitar, upright bass, harmonica, soft percussion, mournful and reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From Babylon we came back home
Walking down the dusty road
Zerubbabel led the way
We carried light to break the night

[Chorus]
Sons of Lebanah and Sons of Hagabah
Names written in the holy book
Sons of Akkub walking through
Restoring what was torn and lost

[Verse]
Temple servants with no name
Sons of Ziha and Hasupha
Serving God in humble way
Rebuilding faith that stayed with us

[Chorus]
Sons of Lebanah and Sons of Hagabah
Names written in the holy book
Sons of Akkub walking through
Restoring what was torn and lost

[Bridge]
Nehemiah counted every soul
Lebana and Hagaba there
Shalmai standing shoulder to shoulder
Duties assigned in ancient air

[Outro]
Lived on Ophel serving God
Ziha and Gishpa in charge
Our names remain in the book
Forever in the sacred page
